steps.summary: Signed in to Grafana at http://127.0.0.1:3000/ as admin/admin (default-password warning appeared; clicked "Skip"). Opened the provisioned dashboard "Service Health" (path /d/bench-service-health/service-health under the Bench folder) — search confirmed this is the only dashboard matching "service". The dashboard has exactly three panels, titled "Request rate", "Error count" and "Latency by endpoint".
